coordinate_convention: Half-open pixel-edge boxes transformed to WGS84. No physical dimensions or subpixel accuracy asserted.
method: All raw contacts inspected before model outputs; enlarged every explicit reviewable water/land scope and quay interface.
Only explicit manually authored boxes and exclusions. Original image bytes, masks and catalog status preserved.
Water-only polygons restrict maritime fondeo to independently inspected water; patios are separate terrestrial controls.
Cloud-mask disagreements are local visual positive windows requiring independent adjudication; no quiet status override.
Empty correspondence arrays are unclassified until later matching, never an empty-label dataset.
